description: GPA Projection simulator enhancements including fail-aware grade inputs, checkbox elective selection with hard caps, and accurate GP=0.00 calculations.

userStories.title: Fail-Aware Grade Inputs
userStories.description: As a student using the GPA Projection simulator in detailed mode, I want to select future semester course grades using a slider that only allows 0.00 (Fail) and grades >= 2.00 to 4.00, so that my projections reflect valid academic grades.
acceptanceCriteria: Replacing the detailed mode number_input with a select_slider in analytics.py.
Display 0.00 formatted as 'F' and other values as floating points with 2 decimal places.
Summary mode remains untouched.
userStories.notes: Replaced number_input with select_slider. Standardized valid GPA points to [0.00, 2.00, 2.25, ..., 4.00]. Formatted 0.00 as 'F'.

userStories.title: Checkbox Course Selection & Hard Cap
userStories.description: As a student in final semesters (CSE 7th & 8th, Civil 8th) where there are too many electives, I want to select which electives I am actually taking via checkboxes and have a hard cap limit that prevents selecting more credits than the semester limit, so that my projection is accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: database.py get_semester_courses() has an include_all_electives flag returning all actual electives.
Identify CSE 7/8 and Civil 8 semesters as having checkbox-gated electives.
Retrieve the semester's credit cap (e.g. 17.5 for CSE 8th, 17.5 for Civil 8th).
Render electives with checkboxes (unchecked by default). Core courses are automatically checked/included.
Disabling unchecked checkboxes when total selected credits equal the semester credit limit (hard cap).
Completely exclude unchecked electives from the GPA/credits computation.
userStories.notes: Added include_all_electives parameter to get_semester_courses(). Implemented checkboxes in analytics.py with pre-pass credit sum to disable checkboxes once cap is hit.

userStories.title: Correct GPA Calculation for Fails
userStories.description: As a student, I want failed courses (GP=0.00) that are selected in my projection to still count their credits toward the semester total, so that they correctly drag down my CGPA.
acceptanceCriteria: In database.py compute_graduation_cgpa_from_inputs, include courses if credit > 0, even if gp == 0.
Ensure live GPA calculations in analytics.py also count credits for selected courses with GP = 0.00.
userStories.notes: Modified compute_graduation_cgpa_from_inputs and analytics.py to always include credits of selected courses regardless of grade.

userStories.title: N+1 Database Query Bottleneck Optimization
userStories.description: As a system administrator, I want the get_profiles() function to fetch student lists in a single batched query instead of iterating database requests, so that dashboard loading performance is optimized.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor database.py get_profiles() to retrieve all profiles in one query, then retrieve all student rosters in a second single query, and assemble the profiles dictionary in memory.
Eliminate the N+1 database queries sequential loop.
userStories.notes: Refactored get_profiles to load all profile students in a single batched query instead of executing a sequential N+1 query loop.

userStories.title: Hosted Streamlit Cloud Performance & Caching Optimization
userStories.description: As a student using the dashboard online, I want UI interactions to be instant without waiting for network or database reads, so that the hosted experience matches local performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap fetch_exams() inside cli_scraper.py with an hourly SQLite-backed metadata cache.
Implement Streamlit memory cache decorators (@st.cache_data) for fetch_exams() and get_profiles() in app.py, pages/analytics.py, and pages/transcript.py.
Eliminate direct network-blocking requests on selectbox changes and UI interactions.
Maintain complete data integrity and automatic cache clearing on database writes.
userStories.notes: Declined caching because Streamlit's @st.cache_data Pickle serialization of large nested dictionaries degraded hosted CPU performance.

userStories.title: Batch Student Data Queries Optimization
userStories.description: As a student using the analytics dashboard, I want the statistics and student cards to load instantly without sequential SQL loop delays, so that my usage is seamless.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor database.py get_student_data_for_exam() to fetch all student grades for this exam in a single bulk query and map them in-memory, completely eliminating the sequential database query loop.
Ensure all GPA and CGPA calculations, fallback rules, and status mapping continue to function perfectly with 100% test coverage.
userStories.notes: Refactored get_student_data_for_exam to load student grades and historical best grades in single bulk queries, completely eliminating N+1 sequential loops in the student loop.

userStories.title: Database connection pooling and data loading optimizations
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to optimize database connection efficiency, index seeks, and data parsing, so that the page load time is reduced by 30-50% on Streamlit Cloud.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a thread-local SQLite connection pool in database.py returning reusable connections mapped by DB_PATH.
Ensure context manager ClosedOnExitConnection commits but does not close pooled connections.
Add compound indices on (profile_name, exam_id) for subject_grades and exam_results tables.
Eliminate WAL checking from get_connection() and move it to init_db().
Eliminate the redundant get_profiles() call in pages/analytics.py.
Pre-filter retakes and improvements in SQL inside get_longitudinal_data().
Move defaultdict imports to top-level in database.py.
userStories.notes: Implemented thread-local SQLite connection pool in database.py returning reusable connections mapped by DB_PATH. ClosedOnExitConnection modified to commit/rollback transactions without closing pooled connections. Moved persistent WAL initialization to init_db(). Added optimized compound indices on (profile_name, exam_id) to eliminate full-table scans. Optimized longitudinal retake queries with SQL-level NOT LIKE pre-filtering. Removed redundant get_profiles() scans in analytics.py. Cleaned up global defaultdict imports.

userStories.title: Advanced database queries and indexing optimizations
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to optimize database queries, index seeks, and import structure to achieve further page loading and analytics rendering speedups.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor get_cross_batch_comparison() to replace the N+1 queries loop over profile names with two bulk database queries (bulk-fetch matching exams using IN, then bulk-fetch GPAs using OR/IN).
Replace the index-invalidating CAST(exam_id AS INTEGER) in get_student_data_for_exam() by pre-fetching and filtering relevant exam_ids in Python, then using an index-friendly IN clause.
Optimize get_effective_cgpa_per_student() latest-CGPA query by replacing the nested self-join with a modern, high-performance ROW_NUMBER() OVER window function.
Clean up nested inline imports in database.py, pages/analytics.py, pages/results.py, and app.py to follow standard styling and remove runtime overhead.
userStories.notes: Refactored get_cross_batch_comparison() to replace the N+1 loop with two bulk database queries (matching exams IN, GPAs OR/IN). Replaced the index-invalidating CAST(exam_id AS INTEGER) in get_student_data_for_exam() by pre-fetching from scan_log and using an index-friendly IN clause. Optimized get_effective_cgpa_per_student() latest CGPA query to use a ROW_NUMBER() window function instead of a nested self-join. Consolidated all redundant inline imports of statistics, base64, re, json, and numpy to their respective top levels.

userStories.title: Trends and Longitudinal Mode Corrections
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to correct retake success stats, Civil consecutive semester numbering, and student trajectory metrics, so that student history trends are reported accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor get_retake_success_stats() in database.py to calculate first_gp and best_gp chronologically based on exam_id (window function).
Update get_longitudinal_data() in database.py to correctly parse Civil Engineering consecutive semesters (when sem_in_yr > 2) and add year title omission fallback.
Refactor student trajectory metrics in pages/analytics.py to use actual semester_num as independent variable for np.polyfit, and bound consistency score to >= 0.0.
userStories.notes: Refactored get_retake_success_stats() to use ROW_NUMBER() OVER window function so first_gp is always the chronologically first attempt. Updated get_longitudinal_data() to detect consecutive Civil semester numbering (sem_in_yr > 2 -> sem_num = sem_in_yr) and year-omissions (e.g. 5th Semester -> sem_num = 5). Added sem_num=0 exclusion to prevent polyfit corruption. Refactored analytics.py trajectory metrics to use actual semester_num as the polyfit independent variable and bounded consistency score >= 0.0. Verified by new unit tests. Full suite: 20/20 passed.

userStories.title: GPA Projection Streamlit Loading Optimization
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to optimize Streamlit rendering, widget tree serialization, and page rerun loops inside the GPA Projection tab, so that the deep analysis loading duration is shortened to less than 3 seconds.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap the rendering of each student card in a helper function decorated with `@st.fragment` to prevent full-page reruns.
Implement roster pagination (10 students per page) in Tab 6 using a clean page navigation control to limit active widget serialization overhead.
Ensure the deep analysis spinner and results load instantly (<0.1s post-fetch) by avoiding full-page redraws.
Verify database and system tests pass successfully.
userStories.notes: Extracted student card loop into a @st.fragment decorated helper render_student_projection_card() for complete card-level rerun isolation. Implemented 10-student paginated views in Tab 6 with clean Next/Prev buttons, capping the active widget serialization overhead to a small constant footprint, resolving Streamlit's WebSocket rendering freeze.
